parameters.jsCode:
// Mock Order Generator for Testing

const TEST_CONFIG = {
  orderId: "NB3-AMAZON-01",
  childName: "Jada",
  childAge: 5,
  skinTone: "skin-brown-deep",

  animalGuide: "unicorn",
  clothingStyle: "dress",
  customerEmail: "john.s.capogna@gmail.com",
  shippingName: "John LaPenna",
  shippingAddress: "12207 Sunset Ave.",
  shippingCity: "Grass Valley",
  shippingState: "CA",
  shippingZip: "95945",
  shippingPhone: "+1-678-478-3477"
};

const mockOrder = {
  amazonOrderId: TEST_CONFIG.orderId,
  orderId: TEST_CONFIG.orderId,
  id: TEST_CONFIG.orderId,
  orderDate: new Date().toISOString(),
  purchaseDate: new Date().toISOString(),
  createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  status: "queued_for_processing",
  marketplaceId: "ATVPDKIKX0DER",
  customerEmail: TEST_CONFIG.customerEmail,
  buyer: { email: TEST_CONFIG.customerEmail, name: TEST_CONFIG.shippingName },
  characterSpecs: {
    childName: TEST_CONFIG.childName,
    age: TEST_CONFIG.childAge,
    skinTone: TEST_CONFIG.skinTone,
    hairColor: TEST_CONFIG.hairColor,
    hairStyle: TEST_CONFIG.hairStyle,
    pronouns: TEST_CONFIG.pronouns,
    favoriteColor: TEST_CONFIG.favoriteColor,
    animalGuide: TEST_CONFIG.animalGuide,
    clothingStyle: TEST_CONFIG.clothingStyle
  },
  bookSpecs: {
    title: `${TEST_CONFIG.childName} and the Adventure Compass`,
    totalPages: 17,
    format: "8.5x8.5_softcover",
    bookType: "adventure"
  },
  orderDetails: {
    quantity: 1,
    shippingAddress: {
      name: TEST_CONFIG.shippingName,
      address: TEST_CONFIG.shippingAddress,
      city: TEST_CONFIG.shippingCity,
      state: TEST_CONFIG.shippingState,
      zip: TEST_CONFIG.shippingZip,
      phone: TEST_CONFIG.shippingPhone,
      phoneNumber: TEST_CONFIG.shippingPhone,
      phone_number: TEST_CONFIG.shippingPhone,
      country: "US"
    }
  },
  dedication: "This is the real dedication field.",
  items: [{
    sku: "LHB-8.5X8.5-SOFTCOVER",
    quantity: 1,
    customizations: [
      { name: "dedication", label: "Dedication Message", type: "text", value: "Luca! We hope you enjoy this story about finding the brave, trustworthy voice inside of you.  Love always, your Dads!" },
      { name: "childName", label: "Child's Name", type: "text", value: TEST_CONFIG.childName }
    ]
  }],
  lineItems: [{
    customizationFields: [{ name: "dedication", text: "Luca! We hope you enjoy this story about finding the brave, trustworthy voice inside of you.  Love always, your Dads!" }]
  }]
};

return [{ json: mockOrder }];
